description: Draws random gates on a clock from a seedable random source, with the chance of a gate set by voltage

params.text: While on, every channel draws its own gate on each clock; while off, one channel of the set is given the gate on each clock, chosen with the channels weighted by their Prob voltages
Sets how many channels the outputs carry, 1 to 16

inputs.text: The clock that draws a new set of gates; with Mlt on, a polyphonic cable here draws one gate per channel of the cable
A trigger here reseeds the random source from the voltage at Seed, so the same run of gates is drawn again
Sets the seed, 0-10V across the seed range, read only at the instant a trigger arrives at Rst; at 0V, and with nothing patched, the seed is taken from the computer's clock instead
Sets the chance of a gate, -5V to 5V with 0V an even chance and more voltage giving more gates; one channel per output channel, and unpatched it reads 0V

outputs.text: Carries 10V on a channel whose draw came up and 0V on the rest, held until the next clock
A 10ms trigger on a channel at the moment its gate turns on
Passes the voltage at Clk through on channels whose gate is high, and 0V on the rest

notes: no gate is drawn until a cable is patched into Clk; with Clk empty the outputs hold whatever they last carried
with Mlt on and a polyphonic clock, the outputs are given the channel count from the Chn knob before the gates are drawn for the clock's channels, so the two can disagree

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
